description: Chooses the film's visual form from the sixteen style presets instead of defaulting to one: reads the through-line, motif, audience and the material's shape, applies the owner's standing preference for animated and illustrated forms over photorealistic footage unless the material is itself footage-shaped, names the runner-up, and records why. The story desk recommends a look in the handoff; Wirecut's look desk adopts or overrules it with a reason.
researcher_question: In what visual form should this story be told, and why not the runner-up?
